final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total_credits, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM actor_counts) SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count * 1.0 / t.total_credits AS credit_share, ac.film_count * 1.0 / t.total_credits - 1.0 / t.actor_count AS difference_from_average FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, ac.actor_id LIMIT 10
